- First, check whether one of the two is just a pending authorisation, since those drop off on their own within 3-7 business days.
- If both have posted, reply with your order number (it looks like LF-123456) and the last four digits of your card. Please don't send the full card number or security code. Once we confirm the duplicate, it's refunded within 3 business days.

**Refund to a different card**
- I'm sorry, but refunds can only go back to the original payment method. If that card is closed or expired, the bank normally passes the refund to your replacement card.
- Alternatively, you can take Leafy store credit, which is issued instantly and never expires.

Could you tell me when the monstera was delivered and roughly how many leaves are yellow? That will help me point you to the right option. Thanks for your patience, and please reach out anytime if you need more help!
